calls.title: Finalize Board Slides
calls.summary: The meeting reviewed the sales team's performance, noting that Q1 enterprise bookings exceeded targets with over $1 million in revenue. The ARR forecast is currently between $14 to $15 million, below the previously set goal. Hiring plans include adding one to two expansion Account Executives and a Sales Engineer, while focusing efforts on large accounts for lead generation. The team discussed a transition to event-based pricing to simplify purchases and enhance revenue from Pro users. Strategic partnerships, particularly with Anthropic, are viewed as crucial for growth, potentially tripling ARR. Financial health shows a steady cash runway, with anticipated monthly burn and plans for improving forecasting accuracy and reporting.
calls.keywords: AI productization, Anthropic, pricing strategy, enterprise sales, expansion revenue, event-based pricing
